name: Coconut-Turmeric Rice Noodles with Edamame, Veggies & Cilantro
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions; drain in a colander and rinse.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
When the veggies are done, return them to the reserved bowl.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, ginger, and onion to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, water, soy sauce, maple syrup, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer.

Once the sauce is simmering, add drained rice noodles, edamame, and cooked veggies to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles are warmed through and sauce has thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges; set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide saucy noodles and veggies between bowls; top with a squeeze of lime and enjoy!
author: Mealime
